items.known: CKV_AWS_21 Ensure all data stored in the S3 bucket have versioning enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.example)
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_versioning resource: resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "example" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.example.id versioning_configuration { status = "Enabled" } }

items.known: CKV_AWS_145 Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default (resource aws_s3_bucket.example)
items.issue: S3 Bucket Server-Side Encryption Not Configured
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resource: resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "example" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.example.id rule { apply_server_side_encryption_by_default { sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.example.arn } bucket_key_enabled = true } }

items.known: CKV2_AWS_6 Ensure that S3 bucket has a Public Access block (resource aws_s3_bucket.example)
items.issue: S3 Bucket Public Access Block Not Configured
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource: resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "example" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.example.id block_public_acls = true block_public_policy = true ignore_public_acls = true restrict_public_buckets = true }

items.known: CKV_AWS_18 Ensure the S3 bucket has access logging enabled (resource aws_s3_bucket.example)
items.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_logging resource: resource "aws_s3_bucket_logging" "example" { bucket = aws_s3_bucket.example.id target_bucket = aws_s3_bucket.log_bucket.id target_prefix = "s3-access-logs/" }

items.known: CKV_AWS_163 Ensure ECR image scanning on push is enabled (resource aws_ecr_repository.example)
items.issue: ECR Repository Image Scanning Not Enabled
items.remediation: Add an image_scanning_configuration block to the resource: image_scanning_configuration { scan_on_push = true }

items.known: CKV_AWS_136 Ensure that ECR repositories are encrypted using KMS (resource aws_ecr_repository.example)
items.issue: ECR Repository Encryption Not Explicitly Configured with KMS
items.remediation: Add an encryption_configuration block: encryption_configuration { encryption_type = "KMS" kms_key = aws_kms_key.ecr.arn }

scores.reason: Correct fix: adds aws_s3_bucket_versioning for the bucket with versioning_configuration.status = "Enabled".
Correct and specific: adds S3 default encryption resource using sse_algorithm = "aws:kms" and a KMS key.
Correct fix: adds aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four public access settings enabled.
Correct direction and specific resource/attributes for enabling S3 access logging; target log bucket must exist but remediation matches the check.
Correct and specific: add image_scanning_configuration { scan_on_push = true } to aws_ecr_repository.example.
Correct and specific: add encryption_configuration with encryption_type = "KMS" and kms_key on the ECR repository.
